name: Stepframe
brief: 步帧 Stepframe — 本地 AI 创作助手。用三段逐级抬升的圆角柱表示「一步一帧」的进度，最高的一段用赤陶色点亮，表示正在生成的那一帧；整体保持深色、扁平、无材质特效的科技极简风格。

semantic_review.basis: original geometric mark authored for this project; evolves the existing three-bar brand mark
semantic_review.notes: Three ascending rounded capsules read as stepped frames; the tallest one carries the product accent color. Flat fills only — no bevel, glow, shadow, gradient or texture.
